executive_summary:
Recommendation: move the discourse PostgreSQL database to four AWS services in three waves, with the target schemas designed for each. Wave 1 moves it to Aurora PostgreSQL, which serves 48.1% of the queries. Wave 2 puts ElastiCache in front of 3 hot reads, 25.1% of calls. Wave 3 moves 42.0% of the queries to DynamoDB and 9.9% to DocumentDB, each workload on the database built for its access pattern. The projected cost of the full modernization is $536 per month at AWS Price List on-demand prices for us-east-1, retrieved 2026-11-04. No current cost was collected for the source database, so the plan claims no saving against it.

Risk: overall risk is medium. The main exposures are two source triggers on category settings that DynamoDB replaces with application-side checks before each write. Both have a defined mitigation in the risk register: implement them before wave 3 starts.

Decision: approve wave 1. It is safe to approve: it moves the database 1:1 to Aurora PostgreSQL, the same engine family as PostgreSQL, with its current data model, and its cutover waits until schema and data parity is validated against the source.
